sentences.text:
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 1623 of 2023
Applicant :- Mukesh Mishra
Opposite Party :- State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

And Another Counsel for Applicant :- Vinay Kumar,Ajay Kumar Verma,Rajeev Mishra Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Subhash Vidyarthi,J.
1.

Heard Sri Vinay Kumar, the learned counsel for the applicant as well as Sri Rajiv Kumar Verma,
learned Additional Government Advocate appearing on behalf of the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed by the applicant seeking anticipatory bail in F.I.R. bearing Case Crime No.272 of 2016, under Sections 354/323/506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of a F.I.R. lodged on 27.12.2016 against three persons, including the applicant, alleging that the applicant tried to molest the informant's daughter and when the informant's brother and another person ran to save her upon hearing her hue and cry the accused persons beaten them with bricks and sticks.
One Ajay Kumar Gupta suffered five injuries in the incident.
A non-cognizable report of the incident was lodged by co-accused Pramod Kumar Mishra on 27.12.2016 itself.
Pramod Kumar Mishra also suffered injuries in the incident and Mukesh Mishra vs State Of U.P. Thru. Prin. Secy. Home Lko.

1 copy of the medico legal examination report is annexed with the affidavit.
4.

The learned A.G.A. has opposed the prayer for bail and submitted that the applicant is involved in another case bearing Case Crime No.12 of 2016, under Sections 419, 420, 467, 468 and 471 I.P.C.
Police Station Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar, whereas in the affidavit filed in support of the application the applicant has stated that he has no criminal history.
5. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, I am not inclined to exercise my discretion in favour of the applicant by enlarging him on anticipatory bail.

entities.text: Police Station Tanda, District Ambedkar Nagar
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: 6. The anticipatory bail application of the applicant is rejected.

However, in case the applicant files an application for grant of bail, the same shall be considered and decided on its merits and in accordance with law, including the mandate of Hon'ble the Supreme Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation & anr.: (2021) 10 SCC 773 without being influenced by any observations made by this court in this order.
.
